scoring_rationale: The worst class-level deviation is the primary criterion.
Mean class deviation and overall split deviation are secondary tie-breakers with lower weights.
Per-class balance is prioritized over exact global 70/15/15 proportions.
notes: Split is group-aware: each thread connected component is assigned to exactly one partition.
No explicit thread-reference group is shared across train, validation, and test.
The largest thread component contains 234 sci.crypt documents and is assigned to train.
text_raw is not used as a fair modelling input; it is used only for metadata extraction.
